inputs.original_text: US-Israel-Iran War Amid escalating Middle East tensions the US proposed a 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran via Pakistan Iran however presented five counter-conditions seeking an end to aggression compensation and recognition of Strait of Hormuz sovereignty Israel remains sceptical of Irans acceptance and emphasises its right to pre-emptive strikes highlighting the complex demands from all sides to end the ongoing conflict
inputs.modified_text: A ceasefire that leaves Tehran with more leverage over the Strait of Hormuz is no lasting peace; it risks teaching that force and pressure pay. The five counter-conditions show the sides remain far apart, and Israel must not be denied the means to protect its people from future threats. America should stand firm for security and order, not bless coercion. When leaders fail to defend vital interests, it is ordinary families and nations that bear the danger.
